asked.item: Only 60 credits shown on day 3 of trial
No bonus credits from signup offer visible; is that normal

verdict.reason: S27-S29 state that promo bonus credits appear only after the trial ends and the first payment processes, and that only the 60 trial credits show during the trial.

steps.text: During the free trial you see only the trial credit balance of 60 credits.
Promotional bonus credits, such as extra credits from a signup offer, are added when your paid subscription activates.
The bonus credits appear after the trial ends and your first payment processes.
